title: Glass Labels with Barcodes | Pane Labels for Glaziers & Processors | Coglass
description: Print a barcode label for every pane — job number, customer, site, opening, size and make-up — and scan glass in at goods-in so the job shows ready for fitting.
lead: Print a label for each pane with the job number, customer, site, the opening it's for and its size. When glass arrives, scan the labels in — and once every pane on a job is in, the job shows as glass ready so the office can book the fitting.
steps_h2: From the supplier's delivery to ready for fitting
steps_sub: Labels and scanning work on any job with glass on it.
steps: One label per pane, printed from the job on a label roll printer.
Each label says which job, which opening and which size — "pane 2 of 4, KITCHEN LEFT".
Scan each label as the delivery comes in — with the shop-floor app's camera, a barcode scanner, or the scan box in the office.
When the last pane on a job is in, the job moves to glass ready and your "order ready" automations run.
inc_sub: A clear, high-contrast design for 100 × 50 mm rolls, with a classic layout too.
included: So the right glass goes on the right van.
The location from the survey in capitals — "FRONT BEDROOM LEFT".
Know at a glance whether the whole job is there.
Width × height in mm, the glass make-up and any processes.
Scanned with the shop-floor app's camera or a barcode scanner.
A company strip across the top of the label.
Scanning a label marks that pane as received against the supplier order.
Text the customer, add a to-do or notify the office when glass is in.
cta_p: Book a demo and we will print a label from one of your jobs — or pick a plan and start a 14-day trial.
